content: WP All Import wizard: 1 upload+type, 2 review the file (record count, one record previewed, next/prev navigation, optional filters), 3 drag-and-drop mapping from a panel of columns onto target fields, 4 unique identifier (Auto-detect) plus New/Existing item settings and which fields to update, 5 confirm-and-run summary then progress then a completion report of created/updated/skipped/deleted. Duplicate identifiers within one file: only the first row creates, the rest are flagged.
